heard: Did you know a honeybee can give directions in the dark? Back in the hive, she dances on a vertical sheet of wax. Watch her abdomen wiggle on the straight run. An angle to the right means fly that same angle to the right of the sun. The longer she waggles, the farther away the flowers are. So, if she runs straight up, which way would you fly?
